answer: One defence is Public transport card tap history: taps on the same card across a city for months, and the saffron of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents barely notice the check, because taps on the same card across a city for months is something they already have; the signal falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The grove grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
